name: spot-eth/options-expiry-drift
title: Options-expiry drift — short ETH into the month-end Deribit settlement
description: Deribit ETH options settle at 08:00 UTC against a 30-minute TWAP, and open interest is concentrated in the last-Friday monthly/quarterly expiry. ETH loses ~61 bp on average over the eight hours before it, so the sleeve is short 1× ETH from Friday 00:00 to 08:00 UTC on the last Friday of each month and flat otherwise.
live_notes: SIM BOOK, NOT VENUE. The rule is short-only and the spot testnet is long/flat. It is a SimBroker with allow_short, marked to REAL Binance spot last price (quotes=binance-public): no order book, no rejection, no partial fill, no borrow cost. Weaker evidence than the venue sleeves.

Flat almost always. It trades twice a month: short at Fri 00:00 UTC and flat at Fri 08:00 UTC on the last Friday of the calendar month. Next windows: 2026-10-30, 2026-11-27, 2026-12-25. A weight of 0 on any other hour is the signal, not a fault.

Costs match the research exactly: fee 10 bp/side, slippage 0 in the runner. The report's cost ladder is 0 bp 1.05 / 5 bp 0.89 / 10 bp 0.71 / 20 bp 0.35 / 30 bp −0.03. A dashboard flatten rebuilds the broker from this file with the default 1 bp slippage, so that one trade costs 1 bp more.

Borderline by the report's own account: sharpe_ci is the 5–95% event-bootstrap interval; net per-event t-stat 1.9; deflated Sharpe 0.70 at 16 trials and 0.48 at 64; three of 81 events supply half the Sharpe (0.36 without them); quarterly expiries show no dip (−8 bp, n 27).

Exit timing is the sensitive leg: Sharpe 0.24 if closed at 07:00, 0.55 at 09:00. The runner raises rather than trading when the last closed Binance bar is not the one that just ended, so a missed 08:00 run leaves the short on until the next successful hour — check the log after each window.

Review trigger from the spec: eight consecutive losing events (backtest's longest run is six), or a cumulative net loss of 6% (the backtest's maximum drawdown). Also review if Deribit changes its settlement time or method.
The same spec on spot BTC has ρ 0.88 with this sleeve — one bet, not two. Correlation with the live spot-eth/eth-trend-filter is −0.06.
